props.name: allowHover
props.description: Allow the tooltip to be hovered over and interacted with. Default: false

props.name: attributes
props.description:
Custom DOM attributes for the tooltip. Useful when you need to refer to a specific tooltip instance by using a CSS selector. Attributes configuration object has the following structure:

{
 [attributeName]: attribute value
}

e.g.:

{
 'type': 'area-tooltip',
 'value': 42
}

props.name: className
props.description: Custom class name for the tooltip. Default: undefined

props.name: components
props.description: An array of visualization components to interact with. Default: []

props.name: container
props.description: Container to where the Tooltip component should be inserted. Default: undefined

props.name: horizontalShift
props.description: Horizontal shift of the tooltip in pixels. Works only with horizontalPlacement set to Position.Left or Position.Right. Default: 0

props.name: triggers
props.description:
Defines the content of the tooltip and hovering over which elements should trigger it. An object containing properties in the following format:

{
 [selectorString]: (d: unknown) => string | HTMLElement
}

e.g.:

{
 [Area.selectors.area]: (d: AreaDatum[]) => `<div>${d.value.toString()}</div>
}
props.type: { [selector: string]: ((data: any, i: number, elements: (HTMLElement | SVGElement)[]) => string | void | HTMLElement | null) | null; }

props.name: verticalShift
props.description: Vertical shift of the tooltip in pixels. Works only with verticalPlacement set to Position.Top or Position.Bottom. Default: 0
